text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to introduce car-share vehicle parking areas (CVPA) on Acorn Avenue in the Etobicoke York District.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on both sides of Acorn Avenue, between Dundas Street West and Montesson Street. 2. Prohibited parking from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Acorn Avenue, between Dundas Street West and Montesson Street. 3. Prohibited parking from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Acorn Avenue between a point 26 metres north of Dundas Street West and Montesson Street. 4. Authorize a car-share parking area for up to two car-share parking spaces for Enterprise CarShare vehicles on the east side of Acorn Avenue, between a point 15 metres north of Dundas Street West and a point 11 metres further north.
